description.value: Anvil Coffee Collective is a family-run specialty coffee shop founded in 2021 by the Rutschmann family in Salmon Arm, BC, with a mission to demystify specialty coffee and build community around it. The café features in-house baking and ethically sourced ingredients, offering something for everyone on its menu. A second location opened in Sicamous in May 2024, making Anvil a familiar stop across two communities on popular cycling routes through the Shuswap.

address.value: 310A Ross Street Northeast, Salmon Arm, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active, operating business at 310A Ross St NE, Salmon Arm with the same phone number as OSM (778-824-0425). The rentals subpage explicitly lists 'Two restrooms' and 'Wi-Fi' as venue amenities, corroborating OSM tags toilets=yes and internet_access=wlan. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café confirmed open via website with two BC locations. A straightforward include for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business has two locations; this OSM record covers the Salmon Arm location (310A Ross St NE). The Sicamous location (#1 444 Main St, 250-253-5130) may warrant a separate OSM/directory entry.
